findings.title: Live translation provider API key is hardcoded in browser-shipped code
Review body and translated text rendered as raw HTML (XSS)

Effect depends on productId but has an empty dependency array, so reviews go stale when the product changes

Translate control is a clickable div, not a keyboard-accessible button
Debug console.log left in component load path
productId interpolated into the URL without encodeURIComponent
useMemo is imported but never used
Intl.NumberFormat is constructed on every call, once per table row

findings.title: deleteTask has no membership or session check; any caller can delete any task by id
